title: WP-PRDY-A: freeze the badf-production-readiness capability contract (G10 readiness aggregator; DESIGNED)
objective: Freeze badf-production-readiness as the G10 READINESS AGGREGATOR under one governance correction: it produces the evidence basis for production authorization and never issues PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED. It owns two of G10's four evidence types -- release-packet and operational-readiness -- never uat (badf-uat's, WP-2026-0115) and never go-no-go (release_authority's own act, human-reserved in badf/authority-matrix.json). Three fundamental rules govern it: AGGREGATION NOT RE-EXECUTION (PRDY-I01: readiness resolves and evaluates upstream evidence, never re-performs the owning discipline -- a readiness skill that re-runs G09's validation has become a second validator with none of G09's independence); READINESS != AUTHORIZATION (PRDY-I19: the ceiling is READY_FOR_AUTHORITY, a recommendation); and PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED IS DERIVED, NEVER WRITTEN (a predicate over valid evidence PLUS valid authority bound to exact candidate, environment, rollout scope, conditions and validity window -- never a hand-written field, because a hand-written boolean can be true while any conjunct is false and nothing downstream can tell). Twelve readiness dimensions each resolve from their real owning gate. DESIGNED rung: SKILL.md + references only.
business_value: G10 names release-packet and operational-readiness as required evidence types with no authoring capability to bind, resolve and aggregate them. Without this capability there is no BADF-native way to assemble a production-readiness basis, and no structural boundary preventing the capability that produces readiness evidence from also declaring the release authorized -- the evidence-producer-as-decider collapse that SEC-I13, VER-I18 and UAT-I14 already prevent at three other gates. This freezes the model so later rungs can enforce it deterministically without a competing validator.
